limitations: Lexical near-duplicate heuristic, not semantic paraphrase detection
Source metadata/lineage and professional-text claim need review; not a privacy certifier
No upstream cleaning history reconstructed; raw sources preserved byte-for-byte
Synthetic author assertions; no relevance labels or independent professional review
One generation cohort; template groups do not imply independent real applicants
Only six template groups; inspect experience-kind coverage before treating any partition as an evaluation set
Known-JD measures new CV on a shared frozen catalogue, not generalization to new JD
Lexical dedup does not guarantee absence of semantic paraphrases
CVs later used to tune parsers/features must become development with their whole family
Data Analyst remains in research scope; repair/review JD on development and obtain fresh usable JD before its benchmark

split_audit.note: Structural partition checks only; no verified labels, identity verification or semantic dedup guarantee

workload.note: Exact count under current sampler/seed and metadata; validation/test census. Not a relevance estimate.
